mission.title: Evacuation
mission.description: Lead veteran operatives whose signals the Machines can trace to safety through hardlines.

npc.say: I'll be back as soon as I can. Keep cool and don't take crap from anyone--especially the Machines!
A lot of people are going to be counting on you. To help them, you'll have to learn to count on yourself.

Me? Nah. Roland made us all get our signals reconfigured as soon as we got a new ship--after Bane. Hurt like a son of a-- Anyway, it wasn't fun, but right about now I'm glad he put us through the pain.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, despite our best efforts, the Morpheus simulacrum did not listen to our entreaties. I've just received confirmation that it has unlocked our RSI signature archive for the Machines. This places many of our veteran operatives in immediate danger of having their signals locked and traced by the Machines.
Ghost and Captain Niobe are among those at risk. They are leaving final instructions now before they have to jack out from the Matrix.

enter.say: Oh man. Anyone who was an operative when that archive was made three years ago could find the Machines knocking on their hovercraft door at any minute...unless they've had their RSI signature changed since then, but that's a real pain in the jack--literally.

talk.say:
I need you to keep it together while I'm out of action, {player}. A lot of key operatives are going to have some downtime while we get their RSI signatures reconfigured, and the rest of you are going to have to pick up the slack in the meantime.
Hey. You can do it. I know you can.

The last five times the Machines destroyed Zion, that was the end: game over. This time, we don't get a reset; the past is still with us, and the future isn't following anyone's efficient plan.
That's a secret I've discovered about leadership: everyone assumes you know what you're doing. The truth is that in a crisis, everyone's just winging it. The real test is how you handle yourself when you don't know the answers.

complete.say: If you're all done with the goodbyes, I've got Tyndall buzzing in my ear.

phase.briefing:
We have many veteran operatives who require immediate escort to a hardline.
Colt is near your location, and has already received a detailed briefing from Commander Roland. I'm routing you to him now.

enter.say:
You know, maybe this won't be so bad. Maybe this will be our time to shine. Hell, we could end up getting a promotion out of this--and I don't just mean posthumously!
Okay, Colt should be in there.

talk.say:
The Machines sure aren't wasting any goddamn time; they already tracked this poor bastard's signal back his ship. His crew blew their EMP... Might have saved their bacon, but he's done.
We've got people dying while we're here jawing, {player}. I'll have my operator give you some of the names of my list. These operatives need to get out, pronto.

done.say: Okay, I'm receiving the list of names from Colt's operator now.

phase.briefing: There are two operatives who need to be evacuated from the indicated location, operative. Lead them to a hardline as quickly and as safely as possible. With their signals compromised, and possibly being tracked or locked by the Machines at any second, it's too risky to have them leave the simulation by any other means.

enter.say: I'm picking up their signals in there. Nothing unusual on my screen, and their signals are steady.

objective.text: Lead Ivo Brandt to a hardline
Lead Lena Sorel to a hardline

phase.briefing: I have just one more evacuee for you to handle now, {player}. Most are out or on their way, but there are some we haven't been able to contact yet.

enter.say: Okay, Lochead's signal looks fine. No sign of trouble in there.

talk.say: Jeezus! You just walk in here dressed like that? They'll be on us faster than--

done.say: Holy--! I've got signals, man--all over the place. They're on to you...
Keep them moving, {player}. I think you can make it.

objective.text: Lead Cherryl Lochead to a hardline
Do not let Cherryl Lochead die

mission.finish:
Well done, {player}. All three of those operatives are safely on their way back to New Zion now, thanks to you.
It will be difficult not having many of our most experienced operatives in the field while their signatures are being reconfigured, but we all have to do what we can. This threat is not limited to operative signal traces, however; the signatures the Machines have obtained will give them access to some of our areas inside the Matrix. Do not let your guard down even for a second while you are jacked-in, operative.
